tools.name: bb_status
tools.title: Bridge status
tools.description: Report the connection to the MCP server, the Blockbench version, the open project summary and whether file-system permission has been granted. Call this first in a session.

tools.name: bb_execute_js
tools.title: Execute JavaScript in Blockbench
tools.description: Run arbitrary async JavaScript inside Blockbench with full access to every global (Project, Cube, Group, Mesh, Texture, Canvas, Codecs, Formats, Modes, Undo, Outliner, Preview, Menu, Action, BarItems, Plugins, StateMemory, ...) and the Node modules a plugin may use. Use this for anything the structured tools do not cover. The code may use await and must return a value; console output is captured and returned. An `api` argument is injected with helpers: api.find(ref), api.findAll(refs), api.textures(), api.animations(), api.sleep(ms), api.readFile(path), api.writeFile(path,text), api.toBase64(bytes), api.fromBase64(b64), api.toast(text).

code.description: JavaScript source. May use await. The value of the last expression / an explicit return is returned.

tools.name: bb_step
tools.title: Run several tools in one request
tools.description: Execute a list of tool calls in order inside a single round trip. Each step is {tool, arguments}. Later steps may reference earlier results with "$N.path" (N = step index, or -1/"last" for the previous step), e.g. "$0.element.uuid". Failures are reported per step and do not stop the batch unless stop_on_error is true.

tools.name: bb_project_info
tools.title: Project overview
tools.description: Dump the current project: format, mode, sizes, and optionally the element tree, textures and animations. Call this to re-orient after a large edit.

tools.name: bb_set_project
tools.title: Edit project metadata
tools.description: Change the open project: name, texture resolution, the box_uv default and the view mode. Use it to rename a project or change the texture canvas the model is authored against.

tools.name: bb_new_project
tools.title: New project
tools.description: Create a new empty Blockbench project. format is a Blockbench format id (free, java_block, bedrock, bedrock_block, modded_entity, skin, image, ...). Always call this (or bb_open_model) before building, unless a project is already open.

create_texture.description: Also create a blank texture sized texture_width x texture_height.

tools.name: bb_open_model
tools.title: Open / import a model file
tools.description: Load a model from disk, replacing the current project (or importing into it). Codec inferred from the extension (.bbmodel, .json, .obj, .gltf, .fbx, .stl, .dae, .jem, .jpm), or set with format (ids from bb_status).

format.description: Optional codec id / alias, e.g. java_block, bedrock, project.

import_to_current.description: Merge into the open project instead of replacing it.

tools.name: bb_save_project
tools.title: Save project (bbmodel)
tools.description: Compile the project to .bbmodel and write it to disk. Without a path, the current project path is reused; pass one to save a copy.

tools.name: bb_export_model
tools.title: Export model
tools.description: Compile the project into another format and write it to disk. Formats: bbmodel/project, java_block, bedrock, bedrock_old, modded_entity, optifine_entity (jem), optifine_part (jpm), collada (dae), fbx, gltf/glb, obj, stl, skin_model.

tools.name: bb_undo
tools.title: Undo
tools.description: Undo the last edit (one or more steps).

tools.name: bb_redo
tools.title: Redo
tools.description: Redo the last undone edit.

tools.name: bb_set_mode
tools.title: Switch editor mode
tools.description: Switch Blockbench mode: edit, paint, animate, display or pose. Paint/animate are needed for texture and animation tools on some formats.

tools.name: bb_set_view
tools.title: Set view mode and camera angle
tools.description: Change the viewport view mode (textured, solid, wireframe, normal, uv) and/or move the camera to a preset angle (front, back, left, right, top, bottom, isometric_right, isometric_left, true_isometric_right, true_isometric_left, north, east, south, west, up, down). Useful before bb_screenshot.

zoom.description: Distance factor relative to the preset (0.5 = twice as close).

tools.name: bb_list_actions
tools.title: List toolbar actions
tools.description: List runnable Blockbench actions (BarItems) by id and name, optionally filtered.

tools.name: bb_run_action
tools.title: Run a toolbar action
tools.description: Trigger any Blockbench action by its BarItems id (see bb_list_actions). This reaches every built-in command the UI exposes.

tools.name: bb_notify
tools.title: Notify the user
tools.description: Show a toast / quick message inside Blockbench. Use it to tell the human what the agent is doing or to ask them to look at the screen.

tools.name: bb_screenshot
tools.title: Screenshot the viewport
tools.description: Render the current preview to a PNG on disk and return the path. This is how an agent looks at its own work. Set crop=true (default) to auto-crop to the model, or crop=false for the full viewport. The transparent viewport is composited over a solid background (override with "background", or disable with background:false). Returns a data URL too when include_data_url is true.

background.description: CSS colour to composite over (default #262b33), or false to keep transparency.

tools.name: bb_review
tools.title: Review the model from several angles
tools.description: Render the model from several camera angles into one contact-sheet PNG and return its path. Use this to LOOK at your own work and catch proportion and texture problems before declaring a model finished. The agent can then read the image file.

angles.description: Default: front, right, back, left, isometric_right, top.

width.description: Size of each cell in pixels.

tools.name: bb_read_file
tools.title: Read a file
tools.description: Read a file from disk. encoding "auto" (default) returns text for text files and base64 for binary; force it with "text" or "base64". Reading uses Blockbench's own file layer and needs no plugin permission.

tools.name: bb_write_file
tools.title: Write a file
tools.description: Write text or base64-decoded bytes to a file, creating parent directories is the caller's job. Uses Blockbench's file layer (no permission prompt).

tools.name: bb_list_dir
tools.title: List a directory
tools.description: List the entries of a directory. Needs the plugin file-system permission (the user is asked once; bb_request_fs can trigger the prompt explicitly). Supports recursion and a glob filter.

tools.name: bb_glob
tools.title: Find files by glob
tools.description: Recursively find files under a directory matching a glob such as "**/*.json" or "*.png". Needs file-system permission.

tools.name: bb_file_info
tools.title: File info
tools.description: Stat a path: exists, type, size, modified time. Needs file-system permission.

tools.name: bb_mkdir
tools.title: Create a directory
tools.description: Create a directory (recursively by default). Needs file-system permission.

tools.name: bb_delete_path
tools.title: Delete a file or directory
tools.description: Delete a file, or a directory when recursive is true. Needs file-system permission.

tools.name: bb_request_fs
tools.title: Request file-system permission
tools.description: Ask the user for the plugin file-system permission (needed only by bb_list_dir, bb_glob, bb_file_info, bb_mkdir, bb_delete_path; reads and writes work without it). An optional scope limits the permission to one directory.

scope.description: Optional directory to limit access to.

tools.name: bb_list_elements
tools.title: List elements
tools.description: List outliner elements with their ids, transforms and (optionally) geometry. Filter by type or parent.

type.description: cube, mesh, group, locator, null_object, bounding_box, texture_mesh, armature, armature_bone

tools.name: bb_add_cube
tools.title: Add a cube
tools.description: Create a cube element. Provide from+to, or from+size (Blockbench cubes use from/to where to is the exclusive upper bound). origin defaults to from. Optionally assign a texture to all faces, set per-face uv, and enable auto UV.

texture.description: Texture name/uuid to assign to every face.

faces.description: Per-face overrides: {north:{uv:[x1,y1,x2,y2], texture, enabled, rotation, tint}, ...}

tools.name: bb_add_group
tools.title: Add a group
tools.description: Create an empty group (bone) to hold elements or drive animation. Position it with origin.

tools.name: bb_add_mesh
tools.title: Add a mesh
tools.description: Create a free-form mesh. vertices is a list of [x,y,z] (or a {key:[x,y,z]} map). faces is a list where each face is either [i0,i1,i2] indices into vertices, or {vertices:[i..], uv:[[u,v]..], texture}. UVs are stored per vertex.

tools.name: bb_edit_mesh
tools.title: Edit a mesh
tools.description: Modify an existing mesh in place. With vertices+faces it redefines the geometry; with merge:true the new vertices/faces are appended. delete_faces / delete_vertices remove by key. Keys are shown by bb_list_elements {include_geometry:true}.

faces.description: Array of indices / {vertices,uv,texture}, or a {key:{...}} map.

tools.name: bb_add_element
tools.title: Add a special element
tools.description: Create a locator, null_object, bounding_box, texture_mesh, armature or armature_bone. Pass its properties directly.

tools.name: bb_set_element
tools.title: Edit element properties
tools.description: Change properties of one or more elements: name, origin, rotation, from/to/size (cubes), position (locators), inflate, visibility, export, locked, box_uv, autouv, shade, mirror_uv, uv_offset, color, and per-face overrides via faces:{north:{uv,texture,enabled,tint,rotation}}. Renaming more than one element at once is refused.

tools.name: bb_transform_elements
tools.title: Transform elements
tools.description: Move, rotate or scale elements. Use vector [x,y,z], or axis+amount. Move translates from/to/origin (cubes) or origin/position (others). Rotate adds degrees around the element origin. Scale multiplies size about the element origin (cubes, meshes, texture_mesh).

vector.description: For move/scale: [x,y,z] (scale is a factor). For rotate: degrees per axis.

origin.description: Optional pivot for scale (defaults to each element origin).

tools.name: bb_duplicate_elements
tools.title: Duplicate elements
tools.description: Copy elements (groups copy their children too). Optionally repeat and offset each copy.

tools.name: bb_array_elements
tools.title: Array elements
tools.description: Create repeated copies of elements along a grid — the correct way to build rows of windows, treads, spokes and so on instead of placing copies by hand. names may contain {i} and starts at 1.

tools.name: bb_mirror_elements
tools.title: Mirror elements
tools.description: Reflect elements across an axis-aligned plane (default x=0). copy=true duplicates first, which is the usual way to build a symmetrical half. Meshes keep correct winding.

tools.name: bb_reparent_elements
tools.title: Reparent elements
tools.description: Move elements under a new parent group (or "root").

tools.name: bb_delete_elements
tools.title: Delete elements
tools.description: Delete elements (groups delete their children).

tools.name: bb_select_elements
tools.title: Select elements
tools.description: Change the outliner selection. mode: replace (default), add, remove, toggle, none.

tools.name: bb_group_elements
tools.title: Group elements
tools.description: Create a new group around the given elements, positioned at their centre, and move the elements into it.

tools.name: bb_set_face_texture
tools.title: Assign a texture to faces
tools.description: Assign a texture (by name/uuid) to cube or mesh faces, or clear it with null. For cubes, pass faces to limit which sides are changed.

texture.description: Texture name/uuid, or null to clear.

tools.name: bb_set_face_uv
tools.title: Set face UVs
tools.description: Set UVs on one face. For cubes give uv=[x1,y1,x2,y2] in texture pixels. For meshes give uvs aligned to the face vertices, or a {vertex_key:[u,v]} map.

face.description: Cube face name, or mesh face key (use bb_list_elements include_geometry:true).

tools.name: bb_auto_uv
tools.title: Regenerate UVs
tools.description: Set automatic UV mode on cubes: mode "faces" (autouv 1, per-face), "relative" (autouv 2), "box" (box_uv), or "off".

tools.name: bb_validate
tools.title: Validate the model
tools.description: Run a static audit of the project and return a score plus findings: empty project, zero-size or degenerate cubes, meshes with too few vertices, untextured faces, UVs outside the texture, duplicate cubes, and out-of-bounds UVs. Fix and re-run before declaring a model finished.

tools.name: bb_list_textures
tools.title: List textures
tools.description: List the project textures with size, UV resolution, layers and saved state.

tools.name: bb_create_texture
tools.title: Create a texture
tools.description: Create a blank texture, optionally filled with a colour. Size defaults to the project texture resolution.

tools.name: bb_generate_texture
tools.title: Generate a procedural texture
tools.description: Paint a new texture from a preset and/or an ordered list of ops. Deterministic for a given seed. Presets: wood, planks, stone, cobble, metal, dirt, grass, leaves, bricks, fabric, skin, gem, noise, gradient. Ops: fill, noise, cells, gradient, radial, rect, circle, ellipse, line, checker, stripes, border, vignette, scatter, pixel, pixels, text, adjust, replace, blend. Example: {preset:"wood"} or {ops:[{op:"fill",color:"#2b3a55"},{op:"noise",color:"#101820",color2:"#8fb8de",scale:2,octaves:4},{op:"vignette",strength:0.5}]}.

preset.description: A named material preset; user ops run on top of it.

tools.name: bb_draw_texture
tools.title: Draw on an existing texture
tools.description: Apply a list of ops onto an existing texture (adds to what is already there). Same ops as bb_generate_texture.

tools.name: bb_paint_pixels
tools.title: Paint pixels
tools.description: Set individual pixels on a texture — the precise way to hand-draw pixel art. pixels is a list of [x, y, color] with color "#rrggbb" or [r,g,b] or [r,g,b,a].

tools.name: bb_get_texture_pixel
tools.title: Read texture pixels
tools.description: Read a rectangle of pixels from a texture. Use this to verify what was drawn: it returns rows of [r,g,b,a].

tools.name: bb_import_texture
tools.title: Import a texture
tools.description: Load an image from disk or a data URL as a project texture.

tools.name: bb_export_texture
tools.title: Export texture(s) to PNG
tools.description: Write texture PNGs to disk. Give a single target + path, or several targets + a directory.

tools.name: bb_set_texture_properties
tools.title: Edit texture properties
tools.description: Change texture metadata: name, folder, render_mode, pbr_channel, particle, fps, layers_enabled, saved.

tools.name: bb_resize_texture
tools.title: Resize a texture
tools.description: Resize the texture image (nearest neighbour). uv_width/uv_height follow the new size unless keep_uv is true.

tools.name: bb_delete_texture
tools.title: Delete texture(s)
tools.description: Remove textures from the project.

tools.name: bb_list_animations
tools.title: List animations
tools.description: List the project animations with loop mode, length and per-bone keyframe counts.

tools.name: bb_create_animation
tools.title: Create an animation
tools.description: Create a new animation. loop is "once", "loop" or "hold"; length is in seconds.

tools.name: bb_set_animation
tools.title: Edit an animation
tools.description: Change name, loop mode or length of an animation.

tools.name: bb_delete_animation
tools.title: Delete an animation
tools.description: Remove an animation from the project.

tools.name: bb_add_keyframe
tools.title: Add a keyframe
tools.description: Add a keyframe for a bone on rotation/position/scale. x/y/z are Molang expressions (default "0"), or plain numbers. The bone is referenced by group name or uuid.

tools.name: bb_delete_keyframe
tools.title: Delete a keyframe
tools.description: Delete a keyframe by uuid, or the one nearest to a given time on a bone/channel.

tools.name: bb_play_animation
tools.title: Timeline playback
tools.description: Control the animation timeline: set the time, play, pause or stop.

tools.name: bb_list_plugins
tools.title: List plugins
tools.description: List every Blockbench plugin that is present, with id, version, source, install state and whether it can be reloaded.

tools.name: bb_install_plugin
tools.title: Install a plugin
tools.description: Install a Blockbench plugin from source code, a local file, or a URL. The code is written to the plugins folder, recorded so it loads on startup, and loaded immediately. Executes third-party code inside Blockbench.

id.description: Plugin id (required unless it can be read from the code).

tools.name: bb_uninstall_plugin
tools.title: Uninstall a plugin
tools.description: Uninstall a Blockbench plugin by id and optionally delete its file.

tools.name: bb_reload_plugin
tools.title: Reload a plugin
tools.description: Reload a dev/URL plugin without restarting Blockbench. Store plugins are not reloadable in place.

tools.name: bb_list_settings
tools.title: List Blockbench settings
tools.description: List user settings by id with their current values. Handy before bb_set_setting. filter matches the id.

tools.name: bb_set_setting
tools.title: Change a setting
tools.description: Set a Blockbench user setting by id (e.g. viewport_zoom_speed, default_cube_size, shading).
